content:
The only possible reason for this security system is that they are hiding Nazi UFOs, underwater bases, submarines, and fortifications. Operation Highjump was not prepared to go to Antarctica with such a large military expedition for no reason.  #ufotwitter   

Operation Highjump as a covert U.S. military invasion aimed at destroying a hidden Nazi outpost called "Base 211" in New Swabia, Antarctica.   

Soviet spies allegedly infiltrated the U.S. expedition, providing intelligence back to Stalin.   

A secret 1947 Soviet report (commissioned by Stalin) described the operation as encountering an "unknown UFO force" defending the Nazis, with disc-shaped craft emerging from underwater, emitting rays or beams, and inflicting heavy casualties on the U.S. fleet—including the sinking of a destroyer (variously named "Murdoch" or similar in accounts) and losses of aircraft and personnel.   

The film cites eyewitness testimony from figures like U.S. pilot John Sireson (or similar pseudonyms in retellings) and emphasizes credibility from Russian military and scientific experts who discuss UFO sightings in the Antarctic region, including Soviet naval reports from the 1970s (e.g., objects emerging near South Georgia Islands).   

It portrays the U.S. as retreating prematurely after just two months due to these attacks, with Admiral Byrd later quoted (dubiously) as warning of a "new enemy that could fly from pole to pole at incredible speeds."
